commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Substitution. Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ragnar Ache walks off.
90+1' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Diant Ramaj makes a great save.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
89' The free kick is delivered by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. FC Koln force a corner. They send men into the box.
88' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
86' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
83' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Sirlord Conteh is replaced by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim).
82' 6:8 – this is the current number of shots on target.
79' The game is interrupted as Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) is flagged offside.
78' Omar Haktab Traore comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
78' Substitution. Marvin Pieringer makes way for Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
75' It will be a substitution. Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) is ready to enter the pitch as Jan Thielmann walks off.
75' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to substitute Alessio Castro-Montes and he is replaced by Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln).
73' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
73' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
72' A cross by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
71' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Diant Ramaj gets down to his right to keep it out.
71' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
69' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
68' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
67' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) will take the corner.

67' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

64' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Diant Ramaj to make a comfortable save.
62' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Fynn Schenten will be replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
62' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
60' Frank Schmidt has decided to make a change. Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) replaces Arijon Ibrahimovic.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jan Schoppner trots off the pitch and is replaced by Adrian Beck (Heidenheim).
57' Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
55' Ooh that was close! Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
54' Rough tackle by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) for a tough tackle.
51' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' A sweet pass finds Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Marvin Schwabe is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
48' 2 - 2 Goal! Alessio Castro-Montes passes the ball to Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Diant Ramaj couldn't do anything about it. 2:2.
46' Half-time substitution. Lukas Kwasniok decided to make a change. Denis Huseinbasic is replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
46' Referee Robert Schroder blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Schroder no option but to blow his whistle.

45+1' Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
45+1' Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
45+1' FC Koln get a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robert Schroder ignores the protests.
40' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
37' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Diant Ramaj, who smothers the ball.
36' CHANCE! Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post.
35' Flag up against Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
33' Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
32' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

32' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Marvin Schwabe, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
31' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
30' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
27' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' 2 - 1 Goal! Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
26' Great touch by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
26' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
23' A cross from Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
22' Close! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
21' A yellow-coloured card is received by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln).
20' A snap shot from distance by Sirlord Conteh (Heidenheim) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

18' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alessio Castro-Montes and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Diant Ramaj was helpless.
18' Robert Schroder blows his whistle as Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

15' 1 - 0 Jan Schoppner sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
12' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the corner which is cleared.

12' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Diant Ramaj makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.

9' He should have scored! Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Diant Ramaj makes an easy save.
7' The game is interrupted. Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
6' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) commits a rough foul. Robert Schroder stops the game and makes a call.
2' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
1' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Heidenheim will take a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Heidenheim will kick-off.
Robert Schroder will supervise the game today.
